name: Xueyou Mixture (Chinese herbal medicine)
short: One study, 65 inpatients with hemophilia: no obvious adverse reaction in 3 weeks, given with an intravenous liver-protecting drug. No safety data reported for 6-12 months of follow-up.
text: The only source is a 2007 study from China in which 65 inpatients with hemophilia took Xueyou Mixture for 3 weeks, together with liver cell growth factor given into a vein each day to protect the liver; no clotting factor concentrates or plasma were given. The abstract does not list the mixture's ingredients, describes no comparison group, and does not say why the liver needed protection. Adverse reactions were an outcome, and no obvious adverse reaction was found during the 3-week treatment period. Patients kept taking the mixture by mouth for 6 to 12 months after discharge, but the abstract reports only factor levels for that period, not safety. No interaction data were found in the cited source.

citations.label: Liu et al., 2007, Chin J Integr Med
citations.title: Study on the efficacy and safety of Xueyou Mixture in treating hemophilia.
